title: A Slow Snail Hunts Fish With Insulin. It Works

scenes.text: A snail hunts fish. Its weapon is insulin.
It's a cone snail, and it is a slow hunter that cannot chase fish.
University of Utah researchers found its venom contains a special insulin.
The insulin crashes a fish's blood sugar and sends it into shock.
Then the snail stretches out a huge false mouth like a net and engulfs the fish.
Scientists think it may disable whole schools of fish this way. Hunting with sugar shock.

description:
A snail hunts fish. Its weapon is insulin.
Researchers at the University of Utah found that a fish-hunting cone snail uses a specialized insulin in its venom to drop prey's blood sugar.
What is the weirdest hunting trick you know? Comment below.
first_comment: Would you have guessed insulin could be a weapon?
